envelope.description: Gate the approval family and close the 2026-11-01 case

body.title: Gate the approval family and close the 2026-11-01 case
body.summary: Call the gate in the dispatcher for workflow.approve and workflow.approvePipeline, hand the handlers the checked repo and rewritten params, remove process.env['INSRC_REPO'] from them, and make handleWorkflowApprove write the store of the named repo instead of the repository found from the path (src/daemon/handler-runtime.ts, src/daemon/workflow-approve.ts, src/daemon/lifecycle-registry.ts use). Update the tests that pin the fallback and add the integration test for the 2026-11-01 case: a daemon whose cwd and INSRC_REPO are a registered repo refuses a relative path with no repo and writes nothing in either repository.
acceptanceChecks: workflow.approve and workflow.approvePipeline called with no repo are refused and the file system is unchanged
workflow.approve with an absolute registered repo and a relative path approves in that repo only
no use of the daemon's INSRC_REPO remains in the approval family

tests.name: approve-repo-gate.test.ts: a daemon started with INSRC_REPO set and its working directory inside a registered repo refuses workflow.approve with a relative artifactPath and no repo and writes nothing in either repository
approve-repo-gate.test.ts: workflow.approve with an absolute registered repo and a relative path approves the artifact in that repo's store only
